# astro-inkstone

> The Astro wiki you can write in — paper-and-ink typography for documentation sites, wikis and digital gardens, paired with astro-inkbrush for in-place editing. This site is the package's manual, written with the package itself.

- Source: https://github.com/jinhseo
- Editing engine: https://github.com/ventusff/astro-inkbrush
- Try editing in the browser: https://jinhseo.github.io/kitchen-sink/

## Manual

- [MetaphorVU: Towards Metaphorical Video Understanding](https://jinhseo.github.io/metaphorvu-towards-metaphorical-video-understanding/)
